summary: Shortlist of 34 CBVs highly recommended for bundle distribution. The selection prioritizes strong recent performance (activity in 2026-10 or 2026-11), sustained activity over multiple months, and promising newcomers with good recent engagement. CBVs with no activity in the last two months (2026-10 and 2026-11) were generally excluded from recommendations, even if they had activity in 2026-09.
